title: AIP-Driven Adverse-Media Summarization for DD Engagements — Prompt Patterns, Grounding Strategy, Hallucination Controls
validation_scope: Prompt YAML mirrors the seed's AIP function definition (target_ontology_object, inputs, system_prompt, user_prompt_template, output_validation chain).
Output schema is a valid JSON Schema draft 2020-12 with all 6 fields from the seed.
Citation-check tool runs end-to-end on synthetic corpus + sample output: 8/8 assertions pass.
Hallucination-verifier prompt template formalizes the seed's two-stage faithfulness check (substring + verifier-LLM).
5 hallucination_gate rules cover schema, citation, verifier, thin-corpus, and no-automated-rating-action.
known_limits: Portable companion bundle; no live Foundry AIP deployment.
Verifier-LLM precision/recall numbers are illustrative ranges (not measured); calibrate before promoting blocking: false -> true.
Synthetic counterparty (Meridian Holdings Pte Ltd) and corpus are fully-fabricated demonstration content; do not use as production tuning data.
Downstream Actions wiring for human review-and-acceptance is Article 005's scope, not implemented here.
regulatory_framing: SR 11-7 / OCC 2011-12 apply. rating_pressure_* fields are ADVISORY ONLY; no_automated_rating_action gate enforces this in evaluations/hallucination_gate.yaml.
